featured_reviews.name: Pranali
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had Gaurav Caterers for our cocktail and engagement function — and I can truly say, they made the evening magical. Since ours was a love marriage, we had guests coming in from all over — Mangalore, Gujarat, Mumbai, Assam — each with their own tastes and food preferences. But the way Gaurav Caterers designed the menu and brought it to life was simply beautiful.

The spread had the perfect mix of veg and non-veg dishes — each one full of flavour, served hot, and presented so thoughtfully. From starters to desserts, there was something for everyone. People kept going back for seconds (and thirds!) — and even today, weeks later, friends and family still talk about “that incredible food.”

But more than just the food, it was the warmth and care in their service that stood out. Saba, their head manager and Abhay the owner, was a dream to work with — calm, attentive, and truly invested in making sure everything ran smoothly. They made sure we didn’t have to lift a finger, and that meant a lot on such an emotional day.

This was also the first time both sides of our family were meeting — and the food genuinely brought everyone together. It wasn’t just a meal, it was an experience filled with laughter, warmth, and connection. In a way, the food helped build a bridge between two worlds — and that’s something we’ll always be grateful for.

Thank you, Gaurav Caterers, for making our special day not just memorable, but deeply meaningful.
